name: iOCO Limited
summary: iOCO Limited is a technology firm delivering a broad spectrum of information and communication technology (ICT) solutions across various international markets, including Africa, the United Kingdom, Europe, and the Middle East. Their extensive service portfolio covers strategic advisory, agile development, artificial intelligence, automation, cloud services, and robust cybersecurity. They also specialize in data management, enterprise resource planning (ERP), financial performance management (FPM), managed IT services, software testing, security and building management systems, and custom software development. A key offering is the ExposeIT application, which assists organizations in identifying and addressing corruption and other wrongdoing. iOCO serves a diverse clientele across critical industries such as mining, financial services, manufacturing, the public sector, and telecommunications. The company, which was originally known as EOH Holdings Limited, officially changed its name to iOCO Limited in December 2024. Founded in 1998, iOCO Limited is headquartered in Midrand, South Africa.
